'''1996 GenCon Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open at Gen Con in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.<ref name="gencon">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gen_Con Gen Con], Wikipedia (Gen Con '96, 8–11 August 1996, MECCA, Milwaukee). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130425022546/http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gen_Con Internet Archive]</ref> [[Michael Mikaelian]] defeated [[Joe Alread]] in the finals.<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref> Mikaelian then played the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="inquest" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' August 1996
* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Milwaukee, Wisconsin<ref name="gencon" />
